newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen's president to visit Germany in September.
newsitem.headline: Yemen's president to visit Germany in September.

text.p: Yemen's President Ali Abdullah Saleh will travel to Germany on an official visit next month, the weekly September 26 magazine said on Friday.
The magazine, the offical organ of the Yemeni armed forces, said Saleh had been invited by German President Roman Herzog.
"(Talks) with the German president and Chancellor Helmut Kohl will deal with bilateral ties and cooperation and issues of mutual concern," the weekly said.
German citizens have been among dozens of foreign tourists kidnapped in recent years by Yemeni tribesmen for use as bargaining chips in disputes with the government.
A total of eleven Germans were kidnapped by Yemeni tribesmen this year. All were released unharmed.
